details.method: For changed C++ targets, run compiler warnings and warnings-as-errors policy matching CI before submitting; retain full standard build and consumer acceptance separately.
details.when: Local and CI builds have different warning policies, especially MSVC class-member shadowing.
details.counterexample: A successful local default build or gameplay run cannot establish /WX compilation; strict single-object success does not establish full linking or installation.
details.trial_plan: Run the changed object with warnings=extra werror=yes, independently review source delta, then exact CI, main and installed acceptance.
